title: tune log
description: immutable agent tuning event log. tamper-evident via hash chain: each batch links to its predecessor via prev_hash. record_hash is computed as sha-256 over canonical json (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the full batch excluding prev_hash. genesis batch has prev_hash = null. independent parties can recompute hashes to verify chain integrity.

batch_id.description: unique identifier for this event batch

batch_timestamp.description: utc timestamp when this batch was created (geographic ambiguity per operations rules)

prev_hash.description: sha-256 hash of the immediately preceding batch in the chain. null only for the genesis batch. links batch n to batch n-1 for tamper-evidence.

tool_name.description: name of tool used (for tool_use events)

error_code.description: error code if outcome was failure

metadata.description: additional structured data about the event. must not include prompt text or reason fields per privacy rules.
